BREAKING: Two people meet. Hearts get involved. Wedding scheduled.

A note from me to you • before our next chapter

Before You Come Home

Mudhita, sometimes I go back to 19 April 2026 and wonder how something that looked so ordinary could quietly change so much. I did not know then that I was meeting the person I would begin missing in random moments, finding in every future plan, and waiting so impatiently to call my wife. You came into my life gently, and somehow made your place in it feel permanent.

Soon, you will walk into my home and, in so many ways, it will be a new world for you. New rooms, new routines, new people, new little ways of doing things. I know that can be beautiful and exciting, but sometimes unfamiliar too. So before that day comes, I want you to carry one certainty with you: you will never have to figure out that new life alone. I will be right there beside you. Not only for the celebrations and photographs, but for the quiet evenings, tired days, silly disagreements, inside jokes, spontaneous drives, little getaways and all the wonderfully ordinary days in between.

“Sheesh mahal na mujh ko suhaaye,
Tujh sang sookhi roti bhaaye.”

Maybe that is what forever means to me. Not a perfect life, but getting to choose the same person through every version of it. Like Naina said, I would happily eat that daal chawal for life with you. With you, even the ordinary feels like something I would never want to trade.

I cannot wait for the day our countdown finally reaches zero, for our seven pheras, and for that tiny moment when I can finally look at you and say, “my wife” ritual wise too. But before forever arrives, another little date is almost here: 14 August, your Sinjara. I hope you love the gifts. More than the gifts, I hope you feel the ridiculous amount of love packed inside them.

Seven promises. Seven circles. One forever. ❤️

AFTER THE SEVENTH PHERA

The rituals may finish in seven circles, but my choosing you will not. I want the slow Sunday breakfasts, the late night conversations, the family laughter, the quiet dinners, our endless TV series binge watches, the road trips, the places we have not discovered yet, and every little version of life we create together.

You, me, a lifetime of moments, inside jokes, little adventures, and all the tomorrows waiting for us. ♡
